script: A valet secretly photographed his own boss's classified documents and sold them to the Nazis for two years, paid in fake money the entire time. In 1943, Elyesa Bazna worked as valet to the British ambassador in neutral Turkey. He copied the ambassador's keys, photographed secret files including Allied invasion plans, and sold the film to German intelligence under the code name Cicero. The Nazis were so paranoid it was a trick that they barely acted on the real secrets he gave them. When the war ended, Bazna went to collect his fortune from the German bank, and found every pound was expertly counterfeited, worthless paper. The valet who sold the war's secrets ended up broke, running a driving school.

description:
